Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.level

Class FloorPlan

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.level.FloorPlan
public final class FloorPlan extends Object
What an Endless floor holds (Q47, Q17): the deeper the floor, the more enemies, of more kinds, with better stats, and one king on the stele. The plan is fixed: the same floor always gives the same enemies.

  • Method Details

    • statMultiplier

      public static float statMultiplier(int floor)
      Returns what an enemy's base HP and Attack are multiplied by on a floor (GDD 1.6): 1 on the first floor, then STAT_GROWTH_PER_FLOOR more for each floor.
      Parameters:
      floor - the floor, 1 or more
      Returns:
      1 + 0.1 x (floor - 1)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if floor is below 1

    • enemiesOf

      public static List<String> enemiesOf(int floor, int spawnTiles)
      Returns the ids of the enemies of a floor, put on its enemy tiles in turn. There is one per tile, plus EXTRA_ENEMIES_PER_FLOOR for each floor after the first, up to MAX_ENEMIES_PER_TILE per tile. Rats come from floor 1, zombies from floor 2, skeleton archers from floor 3, in turn; from floor 4 every 8th enemy is a rat nest. The king is not in the list.
      Parameters:
      floor - the floor, 1 or more
      spawnTiles - how many enemy tiles the floor's map has, 0 or more
      Returns:
      the enemy ids, empty when the map has no enemy tile
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if floor is below 1 or spawnTiles negative
